Search for the project title as mentioned in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment project name for IIT Guwahati Project Scientist - I?
faq.answer: The post is under the project titled "Developing Cooperative Modelled Enterprises for Revolutionizing Commercial Ecosystem (COMERCE), driven by blockchain technology, to boost organic mushroom production by application of state of the art smart IoT/AI/ML Enabled Solar Powered Commercial Mushroom Production (ISCOMP) solutions for the upliftment of ST Community of Nagaland".

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Guwahati Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 01 vacancy available for the Project Scientist - I post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026 (Wednesday).

faq.question: Q4. When is the interview scheduled for IIT Guwahati Project Scientist - I?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 (Friday) at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the total monthly salary for IIT Guwahati Project Scientist - I?
faq.answer: The total monthly amount is Rs. 68,450.00, which includes a recommended pay of Rs. 56,000, HRA of Rs. 11,200, and medical allowance of Rs. 1,250.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Engineering/Technology/Science or a Master’s degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognized university, preferably in Electronics, Computer Science, IT, Agriculture, or equivalent, along with a minimum of 3 years of R&D experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration of the appointment is 11 months.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held in an offline/online format at the E&ICT office, Technology Complex, IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q10. Who can be contacted for clarifications regarding the recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can contact Prof. Gaurav Trivedi (Principal Investigator) or Dr. Anamika Yadav (IPDF) via email at [email protected] or phone at 03612583182.
